# Vaibhav Kodiyan

> Personal portfolio of Vaibhav Kodiyan, an agentic engineer building Rig — a sandboxed
> runtime and review system for coding agents — at Qaynel Agentic Solutions. CS student at
> MIT Manipal.

This is a single-page site: work history, projects, skills, and contact info all live on
the one page linked below, not on separate sub-pages. There is no blog or docs section.
